in_marathi.name: Achhelal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Achhelal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Achhela', which means 'Lord Achela'. Achela is a deity revered in Hindu mythology and is believed to bring good luck and prosperity.
